pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/cron/athena/deps.test.ts:102 The source-scan guard that keeps the hosted cycle tool-less matches raw file text, and the comment at deps.ts:106 ("keeps `tools: []`") already satisfies its positive control. Replace `tools: []` at deps.ts:154 with an identifier such as `tools: ATHENA_TOOLS` and the test stays green: the comment satisfies line 102, and line 103's bracket-only pattern never sees the identifier.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/cron/athena/deps.test.ts:102 Prose satisfies the matcher: the positive control is met by the comment at deps.ts:106, because comments are never stripped.

src/app/api/cron/athena/deps.test.ts:103 The absence check recognises only an inline array literal. Passing tools through a variable, spread or other form evades it silently, and nothing reports the unrecognised form.

src/app/api/cron/athena/deps.test.ts:99 AGENTS.md says a source-scanning gate must strip comments and seed a violation. This scan reads raw text and has no seeded case, so the prose rule is not mechanised and its violation looks like compliance.
src/app/api/cron/athena/route.ts:183 Degraded is not green: errors, truncation or no engine return 207 instead of 200, so a cycle that did nothing is never reported as success.
src/app/api/cron/athena/route.ts:107 A scheduled reaper closes stale proposals as expired or interrupted before each cycle. Each closure gets its own audit row (deps.ts:62-85).
src/app/api/cron/athena/route.ts:86 Skips are counted per reason and returned in the response body (route.ts:167-170), so a skip is never silent.
src/app/api/athena/proposals/[id]/resolve/route.ts:185 The refusal names an action the reader can take (sign in).
src/app/api/athena/proposals/[id]/resolve/route.ts:143 The model-authored proposal payload is re-validated against the current catalog at accept time instead of being trusted as stored.
